subject: Adding a textbox to a ggplot graph

messages.author: 23d559b46612029d
messages.subject: Adding a textbox to a ggplot graph
parts:
Hello all,

I am wondering if there is a way to add a textbox (legend) to a ggplot graph.  I have created the graph below using the following code:

p <- ggplot(data, aes(Survey Question, Rating))
p + geom_point(aes(size=size)) 
+ scale_size(breaks=c(1,2,3,4),to = c(2,5),"Q1: question 1 Q2: question 2 Q3: question 3 Q4: question 4 Q5: question 5 Q6: question 6 Q7: question 7 Response frequency")

As you can see, I could not find a way to add a textbox with question descriptions directly, so I resorted to adding them as part of the scale size label (within the scale_size command).   

Could you please help me with a global solution to this problem?

Many thanks,
Mahtab

messages.author: 5a1b5a9591c118ef
messages.subject: Re: Adding a textbox to a ggplot graph
parts:
Hi,

It's not clear to me where you want this text, but a general advice would be to use grid.text() to place the text anywhere on the device. You could also use grid.table() from gridExtra,


library(ggplot2)
library(gridExtra)

p <- qplot(1:10,1:10, colour=1:10)
labs <- cbind(paste("Q",1:7), paste("answer",1:7))
g <- tableGrob(labs)
grid.arrange(p, g, nrow=1, widths=c(3,1))

HTH,

baptiste
